label: Removable
description: Removable collar stays are slim rigid strips — in metal, plastic, or mother-of-pearl — inserted into small pockets sewn into the underside of each collar point to keep the points flat and from curling upward through the day. They can be removed before laundering and reinserted afterward, giving the wearer control over how structured or relaxed the collar appears. Metal collar stays in brass or stainless steel are the choice of the careful dresser who treats his shirts as precision instruments.
